title: EntitlementRegistry
description: Entitlement name registry (planning/12 §3.1) and the weighted generative tasks metered against credits.monthly (doc 12 §3.3). A `level` entitlement lists its levels lowest first, so the resolver can keep the most generous one (doc 12 §3.2); no other kind has levels. tools/codegen/gen-kernel.mjs validates this file and also checks that every entitlement's kind is declared in `kinds`.

levels.description: The levels of a `level` entitlement, lowest first. A ladder code of SPINE §4 is written as is (`A1`, `G2`); a qualifier joins it with `_` in lowercase (`A1_all_poses`); any other level is a lowercase snake_case word (`basic`). Never renamed or reused: they are wire values of GET /v1/me/entitlements.
